violation_type.title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §746.301(7))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation continues to provide transportation and did not report to childcare regulation the service is being offered.

finding_variants.text: The operation continues to provide transportation and did not report to childcare regulation the service is being offered.
The operation did not notify licensing that they were offering transportation as a new service.
At the time of the inspection it was found that the operation had begun providing transportation in August of 2026 without notifying Chidlcare Regulation before beginning the service.
The center did not notify that Child Care Regulation that it is now offering water activities.

During an investigation, it was determined that the operation was offering and providing transportation services to children in care without any prior notification to Child Care Regulation, as required.
The operation is not permitted for field trips. During this inspection it was observed the operation took a total of five field trips in the month of June.
